title: Detect NAT and public reachability without env vars
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Use STUN/UPnP to learn the public address, fall back to relay, and drop SUSI_PUBLIC_IP/SUSI_TURN_* as required inputs. Tests zc_nat_auto_* with a fake STUN.
